meta.title: Germinal Multi: how a design is judged
meta.subtitle: Two assay tracks, and what each one can and cannot prove

cards.title: What each number means
items: BLI response is biolayer interferometry: a 0.5 nm shift at 1,000 nM counts as binding. It proves contact, nothing more
Apparent K_D is fitted from the association and dissociation curves, so it is a ranking tool here rather than a thermodynamic constant
IC50 is the concentration that blocks half of pseudovirus entry, reported as the geometric mean of two runs in duplicate

cards.title: What the assays cannot settle
items: Binding does not imply neutralization: X58 bound both XFG receptor-binding domains and blocked only one
Breadth beyond the two design targets was measured afterwards, never optimized for - R50 happened to bind all four withheld variants
One off-target check only (PD-L1, no binding seen), so broad specificity is untested

cards.title: What it was compared against
items: The parent antibodies the designs were meant to beat: cetuximab for EGFR, AZD3152 for the KP.3 campaign, BD55-1205 for XFG
Design baselines that score substitutions without an antigen model: ESM-IF1 and FAMPNN inverse folding, and raw AbYsis position frequencies
The best single mutant of AZD3152 bound KP.3 but neutralized neither variant, which is the comparison the multi-target designs are meant to win
